tweets.text:
It is not rocket science.

Iran has a history of transferring oil to Iraqi oil to bypass sanctions. Now it is doing it to bypass the blockade.

By now, everyone and their grandma knows that Prosperity tankers are the main players in the shuttle trade. They remain untouched.

Iran knows this, so why do you think it continues?

More importantly, it's what happens next. Does Iran let the other players remain in the game on the shuttle trade? What will the UAE do in response? What will the US do? And what will Iran do next to escalate?
